title: Platform Reconciliation
subtitle: Cross-verify a platform's payout sheet (Keeta/Hunger/Jahez) against Nerja's own salary records for the same month.

errors.fileRequired: Choose the platform's payout Excel file.
errors.generic: Couldn't generate the report. Please check the file and try again.
errors.sheetInvalid: The uploaded file doesn't look like a platform payout sheet. Check the "Rider LVL" sheet and try again.

matched.title: Matched Riders
matched.description: rider_id matched an employee's Platform ID Number, with a salary summary for this period.

unmatchedInPlatform.title: In Platform Sheet, No Matching Employee
unmatchedInPlatform.description: The platform is paying out for a rider_id that matches no employee (or that employee has no salary summary yet for this period).
unmatchedInPlatform.empty: None — every rider_id in the sheet matched a Nerja employee.

missingFromSheet.title: Nerja Employees Missing From Sheet
missingFromSheet.description: Nerja has a salary summary for this employee on this platform, but the uploaded sheet has no row for them.
missingFromSheet.empty: None — every Nerja employee on this platform appears in the sheet.
